digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center reconciler live integration and mutation testing
propositions: Bidirectional reconciliation against a realistic store copy (real project tickets, not empty) must be proven live: a DC-created issue reaches the local store on inbound, and a local edit reaches DC on outbound, with zero unhandled exceptions and evidence of data movement rather than convergence-on-empty.

The store copy must be isolated from production: no git remotes, no Cloud credentials in the environment, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and a separate repo with no origin so ticket events cannot escape; these must be asserted not assumed.

The copied store must be scrubbed of production Jira bindings and snapshots (.bridge_state* matching glob, enumerated not hardcoded list) to prevent the reconciler from forming intents to write to production keys; scrub completeness must be asserted structurally.

Fourteen inbound and fourteen outbound mutations must each round-trip individually and be asserted against named oracles (not a bare 'converged' line), with idempotence (a repeated pass writes nothing) asserted as a separate cell, and three mutations that remain unimplemented (inbound link removal, inbound parent clear, outbound parent set on sub-task) must report as expected RED until their product fixes land.

Pagination must be proven by observing the server's effective page size, seeding 2*observed+1 issues to force three pages, and asserting all seeded issues are recovered; the fetch must wait for the index to settle and the precondition must not measure itself with the code under test.

Five product defects were discovered and must remain open with their cells RED: inbound assignee update never mints identity (8d68), inbound link removal never emitted (2b16), inbound parent clear never emitted (88d9), outbound status transition never routed to transition_issue (d067 fixed), outbound assignee clear never unassigns (751e fixed).
